instruction: What is the title of the most played song by Jasper Skye on Spotify.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are required (evaluation checks no model changes), so only lookup actions plus complete_task are modeled. spotify.search_artists and spotify.search_songs are public APIs needing no access token, hence no spotify-login action; supervisor.show_profile and supervisor.show_account_passwords are modeled as setup steps required before the artist search to mirror the reference solution. The artist id discovered by search_artists is modeled via (known-id jasper-skye); search_songs with sort_by=-play_count for that artist yields the answer song, whose title is passed as the answer to supervisor-complete-task, which must be last via the (not (task-completed)) convention.
